barn: Purple mold threads through old straw, stall boards, and the timber joints. The broad ground-floor aisle gives access to the empty stalls and stored farm supplies. A separate storage-cellar stairwell is outside against the north/back wall; the roof never covers it. The wooden cellar doors stay closed until revealed; opening them exposes the steps and the entrance marker. No cellar floor is included on this map.
farmhouse: One ground floor holds sleeping rooms, a communal table, kitchen supplies, and a hearth. Violet growth marks wall cracks and the edges of stored goods. For years, troops sent to this farm have not returned. The cause of the blight and their disappearance remains unknown; let the DM’s storyline provide the answers.
workshop: This is a primitive cart shed and hand workshop: wooden wheels, a partly repaired cart, ropes, timber, and manual tools. There are no engines, powered machines, or modern equipment. Purple fungal traces appear among the stacked wood and damp joints. The room has one floor.
store: A small single-floor cottage serves as the food store, with jars, barrels, sacks, and produce bins. Scattered purple mold contaminates the supplies and wall seams without hiding their original forms. The surrounding garden, orchard, well, paddock, carts, and mist are scenery.
